issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'Chỉ có' (Only/Only there is) at the beginning, which is not present in the Greek text ('εις').

The Vietnamese translates 'παντων' as 'mọi người' (all people), whereas the Greek 'παντων' is the genitive plural of 'πᾶς' (all/every), which in this context usually refers to 'all things' or 'all' generally, not specifically 'people'.
